
Lojban-internal name for [[cmavo|cmavo]] of [[selma'o|selma'o]] BAI, and also [[jbocre: PU|PU]], [[jbocre: ZAhO|ZAhO]], etc. Anything that can tag a [[sumti|sumti]].

The full list is:

# [[fi'o|fi'o]] + [[selbri|selbri]]

# [[BAI|BAI]]

# [[CAhA|CAhA]]

# [[KI|KI]]

# [[CUhE|CUhE]] (i.e. [[cu'e|cu'e]] and [[nau|nau]])

# [[jbocre: ZI|ZI]]

# [[jbocre: ZEhA|ZEhA]]

# [[jbocre: PU|PU]]

# [[jbocre: VA|VA]]

# [[FAhA|FAhA]] and [[jbocre: MOhI|MOhI]] + [[FAhA|FAhA]]

# [[jbocre: VEhA|VEhA]]

# [[jbocre: VIhA|VIhA]]

# [[jbocre: PA|PA]] + [[jbocre: ROI|ROI]]

# [[jbocre: TAhE|TAhE]] (plus [[fe'e|fe'e]])

# [[jbocre: ZAhO|ZAhO]] (plus [[fe'e|fe'e]])

Plus combinations of them.

[[tanru versus lujvo rant|tanru versus lujvo rant]] argues that ''sumtcita'' is a better term.
